title: fix(migrations): regenerate complete baseline for fresh DB support
body:
## Summary

Fresh databases cannot be built from the migration history today. The schema was originally developed with `prisma db push`, so **27 of 192 tables have no `CREATE TABLE` in any migration** (e.g. `ExecutiveShareholder`, the Revenue/Pool/Executive tables, `countries`/`State`/`City`/`Bank`, Blog/Farm tables). They only exist on live/staging because `db push` created them directly. A from-empty `prisma migrate deploy` trips the first time a migration references one of these tables (`20260206_make_executive_role_text` ALTERs `ExecutiveShareholder` before it is ever created).

This PR collapses the entire migration directory into a single complete baseline generated from the current `schema.prisma`:

```
prisma/migrations/
  00000000000000_init/migration.sql   # NEW: all 192 tables + enums + constraints (5403 lines)
  migration_lock.toml                 # NEW: provider = "postgresql"
  <all previous migration folders>    # REMOVED
```

Generated via:
```
npx prisma migrate diff --from-empty --to-schema-datamodel prisma/schema.prisma --script
```

No application code changes — migrations/schema plumbing only.

## ⚠️ One-time step required on every existing environment (prod, staging)

Existing databases already have these tables, so the baseline must **not** be re-run there. After this merges, run **once** per existing environment to record the baseline as already applied:

```bash
npx prisma migrate resolve --applied 00000000000000_init
```

After that, `npx prisma migrate deploy` works normally everywhere (it sees the baseline as applied and only runs genuinely new future migrations). Do **not** run `migrate reset` on live.

Fresh environments need nothing special — `migrate deploy` builds the whole DB from the baseline.

## Verification (against an empty Postgres DB)
- `npx prisma migrate deploy` → creates all 192 tables (193 incl. `_prisma_migrations`), exit 0
- `npx prisma generate` → ok
- `npm run db:seed` → ok (22 AdminSettings, palliatives, etc.)
- Confirmed key previously-missing tables exist: `ExecutiveShareholder`, `RevenueSnapshot`, `countries`, `User`, `AdminSettings`, `CspTier`
- `npm run lint` ✅   `npm run build` ✅
